SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 1, Special Branch
REPORT
File No. ____
S. I. REGISTRY
No. S. B/S/____
Date October 24, 1939

Subject: Communication dated 20-10-39 from the Netherlands Consulate-General
concerning B. Shick and A. Nikolsky-Kossireff.

Made by A. Prokofiev. Forwarded by ____.

1). Inquiries show that Boris Mikhailovich SHICK,
Russian of Jewish origin, the proprietor of Josepho Photo
Studios in Shanghai, he forms the subject of Special
Branch File D-3354/156, is not identical with one B. SHICK
(S.I.N), former resident of Tientsin who was connected
with the Centrosojus in Tientsin and Shanghai.

2). Alexander Nikolaevich KOSSIREFF, Russian, born
on May 25, 1903, at Ekaterinburg, Russia. He arrived in
Shanghai together with his parents in 1921 from Japan
where he is reported to have attended a school for about
two years. On 3-12-23 he joined the S.M. Police as Tempo-
rary Constable and was permitted to resign on 30-11-26.
Some time later he proceeded to South America and is re-
ported to have resided for several years in Argentina
and to have become an Argentinian citizen. Returning in
Shanghai three or four years ago he has been working here
in the Josepho Photo Studios. On 23-3-39 he left for
Hongkong in the s.s. "Victoria".

On 30-3-38 Nikolsky-Kossireff appeared before
the 1st S.M. Court on a charge of "Drunk & Disorderly"
and was fined $3.00 ( or 3 days detention ).

Otherwise he did not come to the notice of
the Municipal Police in connection with any activities of
an undesirable nature.

He is not identical with one NIKOLSKY who is
reported to have been a trade representative of the USSR
at Dairen in 1930.

A. Prokofiev
S. S. I.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特别分部第一科
报告
档案号 ____
S. I. 登记处
编号 S. B/S/____
日期 1939年10月24日

事由：荷兰总领事馆1939年10月20日来函，涉及B. Shick和A. Nikolsky-Kossireff。

由 A. Prokofiev 撰写。由 ____ 转呈。

1). 经查，鲍里斯·米哈伊洛维奇·SHICK（Boris Mikhailovich SHICK），俄籍犹太人，上海Josepho照相馆业主，系特别分部档案D-3354/156之对象，与曾任天津居民、与天津及上海苏联中央消费合作总社（Centrosojus）有关联的B. SHICK（S.I.N.）并非同一人。

2). 亚历山大·尼古拉耶维奇·KOSSIREFF（Alexander Nikolaevich KOSSIREFF），俄国人，1903年5月25日出生于俄国叶卡捷琳堡。他于1921年随父母从日本抵达上海，据称他在日本曾就读约两年。1923年12月3日，他加入工部局警务处担任临时巡捕，并于1926年11月30日获准辞职。此后不久，他前往南美洲，据称在阿根廷居住数年并入籍阿根廷。三四年前返回上海后，他一直在Josepho照相馆工作。1939年3月23日，他乘坐“维多利亚”号轮船（s.s. "Victoria"）前往香港。

1938年3月30日，Nikolsky-Kossireff因“醉酒及行为不检”罪名在第一工部局法庭出庭，被罚款3.00元（或拘留3天）。

除此之外，他未因任何不良性质的活动引起工部局警务处的注意。

他与据称1930年在大连担任苏联贸易代表的NIKOLSKY并非同一人。

A. Prokofiev
特别分部高级督察

S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. 3. D.
Date ____
Tel.: "Hollandia"
Telefoon: 80135/6
Shanghai, 20 October 1939.
9 Quai de France
No.3140.

Sir,

I have the honour to refer to my letter of February 16, 1939
No.498 and your communication of February 21, 1939, Ref.No.D
8264/156 with regard to Boris Michael Shick.

It appears that in December 1932 this Consulate-General has
reported to the authorities of the Netherlands Indies about the
activities of a certain B.Chik (Shik) who was stated to be a
Soviet agent, formerly residing at Tientsin, and who had connec-
tions with the Centrosoyous in Shanghai.

As nothing is mentioned about these facts in your report
I should be obliged to you if you would let me know whether
these persons are identical.

Furthermore Mr. B. Shick applied in Hongkong for a visé
for admission into the Netherlands Indies for his assistant
Kosireff Alejandro Nicolsky, holder of an Argentine passport
E No.06445, issued at Kobe on March 10, 1939.

In October 1930 this Consulate-General reported about the
activities of a certain Nikolsky, stated to be a traderepresen-
tative of the USSR, residing at that time at Dairen.

I should be greatly obliged to you if you would let me know,
if possible, whether anything is known about this person from
a political or moral point of view.

D S S Rsh [手写批注]
(签名) [手写签名]

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
(签名) [手写签名]
Vice-Consul
for the Consul-General.

To the Deputy Commissioner
Special Branch, Shanghai Municipal
Police,
SHANGHAI.

8/10 [手写批注]

荷兰驻华中总领事馆
S. B. 登记处
编号 S. 3. D.
日期 ____
电话：“Hollandia”
电话：80135/6
上海，1939年10月20日。
法租界外滩9号
第3140号。

先生：

谨提及我1939年2月16日第498号信函以及贵方1939年2月21日关于Boris Michael Shick的第D 8264/156号复函。

据悉，本总领事馆曾于1932年12月向荷属东印度当局报告了一名名为B.Chik (Shik) 的男子的活动，该人被指为苏联特工，前居天津，并与上海的苏联中央消费合作总社（Centrosoyous）有联系。

鉴于贵方报告中未提及上述事实，如蒙告知这些人是否为同一人，不胜感激。

此外，B. Shick先生在香港为其助手Kosireff Alejandro Nicolsky申请进入荷属东印度的签证，该助手持有1939年3月10日在神户签发的阿根廷护照，号码E No.06445。

1930年10月，本总领事馆曾报告一名名为Nikolsky的男子的活动，该人当时居住在大连，被指为苏联贸易代表。

如蒙告知，若有可能，从政治或道德角度是否知晓此人的任何情况，不胜感激。

D S S Rsh [手写批注]
(签名) [手写签名]

谨致
敬礼

(签名) [手写签名]
副领事
代总领事。

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别分部副督察长，

上海。
